https://mastodon.social/@andyvaisey@oldb.text: With Out Run PETSCII due for imminent release and CityLab with a few testers for it's first thrashing, I've returned to Spheroid, a port of my Amiga puzzle game released a couple of years ago. The basic game is now up and running on the C64, with all 50 Amiga levels included. I'm working on the soundtrack at present. The SFX option already includes 11 samples, many down-sampled straight from the Amiga version. I'm hoping Spheroid will be released sometime in early 2027. @c64 @EC64 #Commodore #retrogaming #retrogames #8bit #c64

https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.text: NOW we can finally open the tomb and reclaim the sword. Whew. #GameNight #Dragonbane

https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.name: Karen Conlin
https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.text: FINALLY. Grainne gulps down a healing potion (for 9 hit points). What we didn't slay, we chased off. That includes thugs, vampire bats, and a lone harpy. (We killed her sisters a while back.) Tym got his trident back (it was stolen by an orc in the very first session, and that orc showed up here). #GameNight #Dragonbane

https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.name: Karen Conlin
https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.text: Still fighting. Not many adversaries left, though. And Grainne, while rallied, is Not At All Well. The barbarian handed her a healing potion, though, so she'll guzzle that first thing on her next turn. #NotDeadYet #GameNight #Dragonbane

https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.name: Karen Conlin
https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.text: Having rallied from death, Grainne blasted the traitoress with a lightning bolt and reduced her to a pile of smoking flesh and cinders. We ain't done yet. #GameNight #Dragonbane

https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.name: Karen Conlin
https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.text: Grainne is down (negative 2 points). Not dead yet. The traitoress is rummaging through Grainne's pack, looking for the artifact. DAMN IT #GameNight #Dragonbane

https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.name: Karen Conlin
https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.text: The traitoress just stabbed Grainne. Walked right up to her and stabbed her. OOF. #GameNight #Dragonbane

https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.name: Karen Conlin
https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.text: Don't mind Grainne, she's just out here firing lightning blasts. And hitting with them. #GameNight #Dragonbane

https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.name: Karen Conlin
https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.text: I (as Grainne) just made a Last Starfighter reference and our GM got it. GO, ME. #GameNight #Dragonbane

https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.name: Karen Conlin
https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.text: Our GM made the mistake of giving out Factspiration points for telling jokes. If you win the die roll, you tell a joke and get a point. (They're useful in game.) Then, you get to choose another willing PC or any NPC you want to tell a joke, too. We've just killed 10 minutes making the GM tell jokes as various NPCs (including one from like 20 sessions back). #GameNight #Dragonbane

https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.name: Karen Conlin
https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.text: Three of four (perhaps five) players are here, plus our GM. ::eyes clock:: #GameNight #Dragonbane

https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.name: Karen Conlin
https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.text: This could be the night of a TPK. Maybe not, but it wasn't looking too good when we ended last session with a sudden but inevitable betrayal by the woman who hired us in the first place and her . . . minions, I think is an appropriate term. #GameNight #Dragonbane

https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.name: Karen Conlin
https://mastodon.social/@GramrgednAngel@.text: It's Friday night and that means #GameNight is nigh! #Dragonbane
